svg.title: Netspeedy - operational signals
svg.desc: Operational signals: 25+ years in production, 2,500 VMs under automation, 300+ DNS zones managed and 6 public tools. Engineering focus. Infrastructure as code: Hosts, services, routing and runners managed as reviewable desired state, not snowflakes.; Kubernetes and GitOps: K3s, Argo CD, platform services and environment overlays where orchestration earns it.; Automation: Ansible, GitHub Actions, scripts and CLIs that take fragile manual steps away.; Networking and edge: DNS, routing, VPNs, certificates and ingress treated as first-class platform work.; Service ownership: Self-hosted services run with upgrades, backups and failure handling in mind.; Recovery discipline: Backup, rollback, unseal and restore designed in, not improvised during incidents.
